function t1.value32(p18)
	local now = tick()

	if now - 0 >= 1 then
		local v85 = 1 / p18
		local fps = math.floor(v85)
		local v87 = value72:GetNetworkPing() * 1000
		local v88 = math.floor(v87)

		value24.Text = "FPS: " .. fps
		value242.Text = "PING: " .. v88 .. " ms"

		if v88 <= 30 then
			value27.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
		elseif v88 <= 50 then
			value27.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
		else
			value27.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0)
		end
	end

	if not (now - 0 >= 0.1) then
		return
	end

	local Character = value72.Character
	local HumanoidRootPart

	if Character then
		HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	else
		HumanoidRootPart = Character
	end

	if HumanoidRootPart then
		local Position4 = Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position

		value28.Text = string.format("X: %.0f Y: %.0f Z: %.0f", Position4.X, Position4.Y, Position4.Z)

		return
	end

	value28.Text = "X: 0 Y: 0 Z: 0"
end

t1.value42(Player, "アニメーション無効", function(p42)
	local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

	if not Character then
		return
	end

	local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local Animate = Character:FindFirstChild("Animate")

	if p42 then
		if Animate then
			Animate.Disabled = true
		end

		local Animator = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

		if Animator then
			for _, v in pairs(Animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
				v:Stop(0)
			end

			connection = Animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(p43)
				p43:Stop(0)
			end)
		end

		RunService:BindToRenderStep("FreezeJointsLoop", Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value + 1, function()
			local v179 = Character

			for _, descendant in pairs(v179.GetDescendants(v179)) do
				if descendant:IsA("Motor6D") then
					descendant.Transform = CFrame.new()
				end
			end
		end)

		return
	end

	RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("FreezeJointsLoop")

	if connection then
		connection:Disconnect()
	end

	if not Animate then
		Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)

		return
	end

	Animate.Disabled = false
	Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
end)

		end
	end
end)

t1.value44(Player, "チーム変更", "海賊/海軍を切り替えます", function()
	local LocalPlayer2 = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
	local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")

	if Remotes then
		Remotes = Remotes:FindFirstChild("CommF_")
	end

	if Remotes then
		pcall(function()
			local Team = LocalPlayer2.Team

			if not Team then
				if string.find(Team or "", "Pirates") then
					Remotes:InvokeServer("SetTeam", "Marines")
				else
					Remotes:InvokeServer("SetTeam", "Pirates")
				end

				return
			end

			Team = LocalPlayer2.Team.Name

			if string.find(Team or "", "Pirates") then
				Remotes:InvokeServer("SetTeam", "Marines")
			else
				Remotes:InvokeServer("SetTeam", "Pirates")
			end
		end)
	else
		pcall(function()
			ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.CommF_:InvokeServer("SetTeam", "Pirates")
		end)
	end
end)
value3.Stepped:Connect(function()
	local Character = value72.Character
	local Humanoid

	if Character then
		Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	else
		Humanoid = Character
	end

	local HumanoidRootPart

	if Character then
		HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	else
		HumanoidRootPart = Character
	end

	local v195

	if Character then
		v195 = HumanoidRootPart and Humanoid
	else
		v195 = Character
	end

	if not v195 then
		return
	end

	if u144 then
		local GetDescendants = Character.GetDescendants

		for _, v in pairs(GetDescendants(Character)) do
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				v.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end

	if u140 then
		local MoveDirection = Humanoid.MoveDirection

		if MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = Vector3.new(MoveDirection.X * n1, HumanoidRootPart.Velocity.Y, MoveDirection.Z * n1)
		end
	end

	if not u142 then
		return
	end

	Humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
	Humanoid.JumpPower = jumpPower
end)

local function v201(player)
	if player == value72 then
		return
	end

	local Square = Drawing.new("Square")
	local Line = Drawing.new("Line")
	local Text = Drawing.new("Text")
	local Text2 = Drawing.new("Text")
	local Text3 = Drawing.new("Text")

	for _, v in pairs({ Text, Text2, Text3 }) do
		v.Size = v == Text and 18 or 14
		v.Center = true
		v.Outline = true
		v.Visible = false
	end

	local v209 = nil
	local RenderStepped = value3.RenderStepped

	v209 = RenderStepped.Connect(RenderStepped, function()
		if not (player and player.Parent) then
			Square.Visible = false
			Line.Visible = false
			Text.Visible = false
			Text2.Visible = false
			Text3.Visible = false
			Square:Remove()
			Line:Remove()
			Text:Remove()
			Text2:Remove()
			Text3:Remove()
			v209:Disconnect()

			return
		end

		local Character = player.Character
		local HumanoidRootPart

		if Character then
			HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		else
			HumanoidRootPart = Character
		end

		if Character then
			Character = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		end

		local v213

		if HumanoidRootPart then
			if Character then
				v213 = Character.Health > 0
			else
				v213 = Character
			end
		else
			v213 = HumanoidRootPart
		end

		if not v213 then
			Square.Visible = false
			Line.Visible = false
			Text.Visible = false
			Text2.Visible = false
			Text3.Visible = false

			return
		end

		local v214, v215 = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(HumanoidRootPart.Position)

		if not v215 then
			Square.Visible = false
			Line.Visible = false
			Text.Visible = false
			Text2.Visible = false
			Text3.Visible = false

			return
		end

		local color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		local Team = player.Team

		if Team then
			Team = player.Team.Name
		end

		if not Team then
			local Data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")

			if Data then
				Data = player.Data:FindFirstChild("Team")

				if Data then
					Data = player.Data.Team.Value
				end
			end

			Team = Data or ""
		end

		if string.find(Team, "Pirate") then
			color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		elseif string.find(Team, "Marine") then
			color3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 190, 255)
		end

		local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local Position4 = HumanoidRootPart.Position
		local Vector3_ = Vector3
		local v222 = CurrentCamera.WorldToViewportPoint(CurrentCamera, Position4 + Vector3_.new(0, 3, 0))
		local CurrentCamera2 = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local Position5 = HumanoidRootPart.Position
		local Vector3_2 = Vector3
		local v226 = CurrentCamera2.WorldToViewportPoint(CurrentCamera2, Position5 - Vector3_2.new(0, 3.5, 0))
		local v227 = v222.Y - v226.Y
		local v228 = math.abs(v227)
		local v229 = v228 * 0.55

		Square.Visible = t8.Box
		Square.Size = Vector2.new(v229, v228)
		Square.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X - v229 / 2, v214.Y - v228 / 2)
		Square.Color = color3
		Square.Thickness = 1
		Line.Visible = t8.Tracer
		Line.From = Vector2.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2, workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y)
		Line.To = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y + v228 / 2)
		Line.Color = color3

		local Data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")

		if not Data then
			Text.Visible = t8.Name
			Text.Text = (player.DisplayName or player.Name) .. " [Lv." .. (Data or "?") .. "]"
			Text.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y - v228 / 2 - 30)
			Text.Color = color3
			Text2.Visible = t8.Health
			v272 = Text2
			v273 = Character.Health
			v272.Text = "HP: " .. math.floor(v273)
			Text2.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y - v228 / 2 - 55)
			Text2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
			Text3.Visible = t8.Distance
			v274 = (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			Text3.Text = math.floor(v274) .. "m"
			Text3.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y + v228 / 2 + 10)
			Text3.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

			return
		end

		Data = player.Data:FindFirstChild("Level")

		if not Data then
			Text.Visible = t8.Name
			Text.Text = (player.DisplayName or player.Name) .. " [Lv." .. (Data or "?") .. "]"
			Text.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y - v228 / 2 - 30)
			Text.Color = color3
			Text2.Visible = t8.Health
			v272 = Text2
			v273 = Character.Health
			v272.Text = "HP: " .. math.floor(v273)
			Text2.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y - v228 / 2 - 55)
			Text2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
			Text3.Visible = t8.Distance
			v274 = (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
			Text3.Text = math.floor(v274) .. "m"
			Text3.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y + v228 / 2 + 10)
			Text3.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

			return
		end

		Data = player.Data.Level.Value
		Text.Visible = t8.Name
		Text.Text = (player.DisplayName or player.Name) .. " [Lv." .. (Data or "?") .. "]"
		Text.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y - v228 / 2 - 30)
		Text.Color = color3
		Text2.Visible = t8.Health

		local v231 = Text2
		local Health = Character.Health

		v231.Text = "HP: " .. math.floor(Health)
		Text2.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y - v228 / 2 - 55)
		Text2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
		Text3.Visible = t8.Distance

		local Magnitude = (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

		Text3.Text = math.floor(Magnitude) .. "m"
		Text3.Position = Vector2.new(v214.X, v214.Y + v228 / 2 + 10)
		Text3.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end)
end

	v201(player)
end

			t9.value13 = false
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.StrafingNoPhysics, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, true)
			t9.value14.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics)
		else
			t9.value13 = true

			for _ = 1, t9.value12 do
				spawn(function()
					local Heartbeat = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat

					tpwalking = true

					local Character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
					local Humanoid

					if Character then
						Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
					else
						Humanoid = Character
					end

					while true do
						local tpwalking_ = tpwalking

						if tpwalking_ then
							tpwalking_ = Heartbeat:Wait()

							if tpwalking_ then
								if Character then
									if Humanoid then
										tpwalking_ = Humanoid.Parent
									else
										tpwalking_ = Humanoid
									end
								else
									tpwalking_ = Character
								end
							end
						end

						if not tpwalking_ then
							return
						end

						if Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
							Character:TranslateBy(Humanoid.MoveDirection)
						end
					end
				end)
			end

			game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Animate.Disabled = true

			local Character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
			local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
			local GetPlayingAnimationTracks = Humanoid.GetPlayingAnimationTracks
			local next_ = next
			local v291, key = GetPlayingAnimationTracks(Humanoid)

			while true do
				local v293

				key, v293 = next_(v291, key)

				if not key then
					break
				end

function t1.value69(p79)
	local Character = value72.Character
	local HumanoidRootPart

	if Character then

	else

	end

		v588 = s1 ~= ""
	end

		value66.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -1000, 0)

		local Character2 = value6[s1].Character

		if Character2 and (HumanoidRootPart and Character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
			value66.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame

			local cFrame = Character2.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(vector3.X, vector3.Y, vector3.Z)

			if s2 == "TP" then
				value66.CFrame = cFrame
			else

				else
					RemoteFunction = Awakening
				end

				if RemoteFunction then
					Awakening.RemoteFunction:InvokeServer(true)
				end
			end
		end

		if not (_G.AutoRaceV3_Ability and value88(Character)) then
			return
		end

		local v770 = false

		while true do
			local v771

			v769, v771 = v767(v768, v769)

			if not v769 then
				break
			end

			if value702.Backpack:FindFirstChild(v771) or Character:FindFirstChild(v771) then
				v770 = true

				break
			end
		end

		if not v770 then
			return
		end

		n8 = n8 - p102

		if not (n8 <= 0) then
			return
		end

		value89.Remotes.CommE:FireServer("ActivateAbility")
	end

			while true do

		return

	end

		return
	end

end
